# Ryzenth Docs API

### 🧠 **Humanizer API V2 is live!**

```py
import requests

text = ""
author_id = ""
writing_style = ""
timestamp = "null"

url = f"http://ryzenth.randydev.my.id/v2/fast/ai/r/Ryzenth-Humanize-05-06-2025"

params = {
  "text": text,
  "author_id": author_id,
  "writing_style": writing_style,
  "timestamp":timestamp
}

response = requests.get(url, params=params).json()
print(response)
```
